title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand — Episode8 Guiding Warmth

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Event Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: The next day
Ryusuiso - Lobby

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do we have all our things?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup, all set!
Miku and the others ran a quick check for us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And your tickets for the trip back are tucked away in your pockets!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sounds like we're ready!
As much as I hate to, let's head out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we should also thank Saito and...
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, your timing is impeccable!
We were just about to go thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for these past three days.
The food was delicious and the baths were wonderful. We feel so refreshed that it's easy to forget that we came here for work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Work or no work, we promise to come again!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe. The proprietress is going to enjoy hearing that. We hope to see you back again soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we'll be leaving now, but do you know when you're going to be back in Tokyo?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I plan on going back once the festival is over and things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We wish you the best of luck.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When you do return, we'd like to have another discussion about you becoming our manager.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next time, we promise to have the details regarding your contract all sorted, including your compensation.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, of course...
If you think becoming the manager of MORE MORE JUMP! isn't what you want to do, please feel free to turn us down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
After all, you fulfilling your dream is what matters most to us.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm afraid that I not only caused Shizuku a lot of trouble, but made you all worry about me too.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After all of that, my mind is already made up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I don't need to see my contract.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Please! Let me become your manager!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, slow down.
We're not exactly in any position to talk since we rushed into asking you the other day...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we can't really agree to anything before we have your contract figured out. We've gotta hammer all that out first.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No, I don't care!
I owe you all an enormous debt!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A debt? No, we didn't do anything like...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, you did!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You turned my vague wishes into a concrete dream. You made me want to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And this time, you gave me the courage to go after my dream!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I don't know how I'm ever going to repay you all for what you've done.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But I promise to do what I can.
I'll do anything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: O-Okay, maybe that's going a little too far. But in any case...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I know that being a manager is the furthest thing from easy. I'm going to have to be there for all of you during more than just events and such.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I've never been a manager before...
I've studied how to be one a little, but I'm still just a student. I have no real-world experience. Regardless...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I vow to do everything in my power to let everyone out there know how great MORE MORE JUMP! is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I don't plan on receiving any special treatment just because I have zero experience. My goal will be to get this group whatever jobs you want from wherever I can.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Until all your dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No, beyond that...
I want to witness what you're all going to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Please, let me be your manager!
I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Saito.
Your words have left us elated.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
...!
Then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We would love to have you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We know you didn't make this decision lightly, and I promise to never forget that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so excited.
We really get to go on this journey together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, now that we're together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Your dreams, our dreams...
Let's do our best to make them all come true!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's so wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But really, let's have another discussion soon regarding your contract...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, since you won't be able to make a living on zero pay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, we won't make you sign anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I'll let you all know once I'm back in Tokyo.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is so great!
You're really gonna be our manager!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means our next event's guaranteed to be super spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We'll need to start hammering out all the details for that.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm still in talks with that one venue, so it may be good for us to work on some of your ideas while we wait to hear back from them.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: While we're at it, would you mind sharing your schedule with me again? I'd like to book a place for our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's so kind of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be huge.
We always have a hard time booking rental meeting rooms during our free time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sometimes the place we want is completely booked... Whenever that happens, we have to find somewhere else on the fly, which is always really tough...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, those sorts of little things can add up to a lot of time lost. But I'll be taking care of all that from now on!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Still, it would be nice to have a dedicated place where you could all meet and practice whenever you like. Most of the big agencies have buildings just for those purposes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that's one of the drawbacks of freelancing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
And it's not like we can just build one ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Build one ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, why don't we do that?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We're gonna build a house?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's probably out of the question.
But buying isn't our only option. We can always rent.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That seems a lot more realistic, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A place where we can practice, have meetings, shoot and edit videos—every aspect of our work. A place MORE MORE JUMP! can call home.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We can call it...
The MORE MORE HOUSE!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE?!
